name: Map My Customers
description: Map My Customers is a mobile field-sales CRM for mapping accounts, planning routes and territories, tracking activities, managing contacts and deals, and reporting on sales-team execution.
agentUseSummary: Map My Customers cannot yet be connected through Relay. The provider documents a broad customer-data API, but access is issued only after a support request and the anonymous official materials do not provide one consistent base URL and version or the credential exchange, refresh, revocation, organization-binding, and distribution contract needed for a safe connector.

blocked.label: Connect Map My Customers
blocked.description: Relay cannot request or store credentials until Map My Customers supplies the exact credential fields, exchange and refresh lifecycle, revocation behavior, customer-organization binding, and distributable integration terms.

blocked.label: Read Map My Customers data
blocked.description: Accounts, contacts, deals, activities, routes, locations, territories, mileage, users, teams, funnels, stages, custom fields, groups, and other customer records remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change Map My Customers data
blocked.description: Creating, updating, bulk importing, bulk updating, deleting, assigning, or otherwise changing CRM, route, territory, location, activity, and administrative records is blocked.

blocked.label: Use field-sales location data
blocked.description: Relay does not expose customer addresses, user locations, routes, territories, mileage, check-ins, or other geospatial and workforce data without an approved least-privilege contract.

blocked.label: Use private or raw interfaces
blocked.description: Browser automation, account passwords, session cookies, provider-console access, private endpoints, arbitrary raw requests, SFTP, Zapier indirection, and undocumented synchronization are blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: Map My Customers states that public API access is available only by request through support or an account manager, after which the provider supplies credentials. Its public integrations page shows bearer-key examples at https://api.mapmycustomers.com/v3, while the current developer reference documents organization-scoped resources and an OAuth token endpoint at https://api.mapmycustomers.me. The anonymous reference does not disclose the credential request payload, credential ownership, token and refresh expiry, rotation and revocation, exact organization binding, rate limits, idempotency, or the terms under which Relay may distribute a customer-facing connector. The API can read and mutate sensitive CRM, location, route, territory, activity, user, and administrative data, including bulk operations, so Relay must not infer the missing contract.
providerSetup.nextAction: In a separately authorized provider-access task, an entitled customer and Map My Customers support or account manager must supply the current integration agreement, credential issuance and ownership model, exact production and test origins and API version, token request fields, access and refresh lifecycle, revocation and disconnect behavior, organization and user identity calls, permissions, resource schemas, pagination, rate limits, idempotency, bulk and deletion semantics, error model, and representative test account. Product, security, privacy, legal, runtime, and customer owners must then approve a least-privilege V1 resource set and Safe approval policy before typed bounded wrappers and production acceptance are implemented.

evidence.supports: Map My Customers describes a mobile field-sales CRM for account mapping, route planning, territory management, activity tracking, deal management, reporting, and sales execution.
The official integrations page offers a public API, native CRM sync, SFTP, imports, and Zapier; its bearer-key samples use api.mapmycustomers.com/v3 for companies, activities, deals, and routes.
Map My Customers states that API access is by request only: a customer contacts support or their account manager and receives provider-issued credentials.

The current official reference documents organization-scoped accounts, contacts, deals, activities, routes, locations, users, teams, funnels, stages, territories, mileage, custom fields, and groups, including broad bulk and administrative operations on the api.mapmycustomers.me origin.

The official reference identifies an api.mapmycustomers.me OAuth token endpoint that generates access and refresh tokens, but the anonymous page does not expose the provider-issued credential fields or complete lifecycle contract Relay would need to implement it safely.

The current privacy policy treats contact information, account records, sales activity, notes, location, and other customer information as sensitive data governed by customer controls and privacy commitments.
